name: Happy Path - Download Own Appraisal Letter for 2024
goal: User requests their own appraisal letter for 2024 and downloads it via provided link.
constraints: User selects 2024 from quick replies. Download delivery selected. Tool returns webViewLink.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years' and isManagerAllowed is 'no'.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and provides webViewLink.

phases.description: Bot shows link and asks for further questions.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes download link and 'Do you have any other questions?'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
